fields.name: num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key (`player.items[num]`), so a number or a numeric string; any other value is an empty slot
fields.description: The slot of the booster: `xpbooster`, `luckbooster` or `goldbooster`.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The sub-action. Each value is a variant (below). `activate` starts the time of the booster. `shift` changes the booster to the type in `to`. Any other value (or none) changes nothing, but sends the success reply.

list.when: Starts the time of the booster: `expires` is now plus 30 days plus 2 days per level of the item. On a booster that has `expires` already, nothing changes.
Changes the booster to the type in `to`. It also sets `xpm`, `goldm` and `luckm` to 1, and adds 240 ms to `penalty_cd` (up to 120,000 ms).

fields.name: to
fields.coerce: strict: `booster_items.includes(to)`, so it must be one of these strings
fields.description: The new booster type. It can be the same type.

list.name: Other
list.when: Any other value, or no `action`: nothing changes, but the success reply comes.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Any value other than `"activate"` and `"shift"`, or no value.

confirm.note: Neither branch runs; the success reply still comes

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The checks pass. Also for `activate` on a booster that has `expires` already, and for an unknown `action`: then nothing changes.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the booster now (after a `shift`, the new type).

rows.when: The payload is `null` (or another falsy value). This handler checks it, so there is no `game_error`.
The slot is empty, or the item is not a booster.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. The booster in `items[num]` has its new `name` or `expires`.
